system.boundary: Build a four-wheel vehicle model that traverses spatially uneven terrain while regulating forward speed in closed loop.
physical_paths: The control law is not prescribed, but it must use measured vehicle or wheel behavior to regulate speed through actual wheel torque and must react to the temporary actuator loss.
functional_paths: Build a four-wheel vehicle model that traverses spatially uneven terrain while regulating forward speed in closed loop.
Use a 0.34 m effective tire radius, a 1.60 m track width, and a 3.00 m wheelbase.
The two wheels on one side encounter the same spatial track with the rear axle delayed by the wheelbase;
information_paths: speed_reference, initial_speed, vehicle_mass, road_amplitude, road_wavelength, left_right_phase, drive_loss_fraction, drive_loss_time -> F90-XAUTO-02 plant/control path -> body_state, axle_state, wheel_contact, actuation
modes_and_events: Build a four-wheel vehicle model that traverses spatially uneven terrain while regulating forward speed in closed loop.
The model should keep the vehicle bounded, retain useful tire contact, limit wheel slip and body attitude, and recover speed regulation over the declared joint range.

interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log four complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named body_state, axle_state, wheel_contact, and actuation. axle_state has 8 channels in this order: front heave (m), front heave rate (m/s), front roll (rad), front roll rate (rad/s), rear heave (m), rear heave rate (m/s), rear roll (rad), and rear roll rate (rad/s).

interfaces.name: wheel_contact
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
units: [rad/s x4,1 x4,N x4,N x4,m x4,m x4]
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log four complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named body_state, axle_state, wheel_contact, and actuation. wheel_contact has 24 channels: four wheel angular speeds (rad/s), four longitudinal slip ratios (1), four tire normal forces (N), four tire longitudinal forces (N), four local road heights (m), and four tire vertical deflections (m), using FL, FR, RL, RR order within every group.

interfaces.name: actuation
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log four complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named body_state, axle_state, wheel_contact, and actuation. actuation has 10 channels: four requested wheel torques (N*m), four delivered wheel torques (N*m), measured speed error (m/s), and the physical right-side loss indicator (1).
